recommendations: Replace InvestmentLab startup CMD with hidden VBS pythonw launcher, preserving loop arguments.
Use a persistent remote supervisor that reuses remote process but keeps monitoring, retries nonzero exits, and respects explicit program stop state.
Do not add universal AutoEndTasks/force shutdown: unrelated unsaved apps must not be killed.
Keep remote supervisor disabled during Windows shutdown/logoff to avoid resurrection or delayed shutdown.
Track third-party crash/hang evidence separately from proven AI startup issues.
